work.name: Comulate
work.summary: Developing an autonomous insurance servicing agent alongside ML engineers and an insurance SME, in close partnership with a design-partner brokerage.
highlights: Architected a unified pipeline for production runs and offline evals, combining sandboxed execution (E2B), webhook-triggered orchestration with dedup/gating, and context assembly over a ~1M-document BigQuery corpus.
Improved agent eval accuracy by ~60% through prompt engineering, harness iteration, and custom tooling to trace agent reasoning, diagnose context gaps, and match workstreams across threads.
Shipped an AI-native email client with source-linked agent summaries, suggested replies, and a diff viewer for auditing agent edits.

work.name: Overjet
work.summary: Led a 6-engineer squad modernizing frontend and backend stacks for a Provider Network Management platform, delivering credentialing and payer enrollment workflows.
highlights: Spearheaded a data model re-architecture to centralize ownership across providers, practices, and payers, eliminating sync complexity and unblocking 3 major payer launches.
Secured commercial contract with large payer by shipping a production-ready Public API in two weeks, replacing legacy Express routes with a type-safe Hono/Arktype architecture.
Migrated test infrastructure from serial Dockerized Postgres to parallelized Pglite, reducing CI runtime by 60% and cutting local execution from several minutes to sub-minute.

work.name: Medallion
work.summary: Built automation and onboarding features across the stack at a fast-moving health-tech startup using Django, React, and GraphQL.
highlights: Introduced GraphQL by building core abstractions and migrating REST endpoints, then drove adoption through pairing and internal knowledge sharing.
Built a high-throughput provider import pipeline using Celery and Customer.io, decreasing turnaround times by 30%.

work.name: American Express
work.summary: Built site and infrastructure features on Amex's GCS Commercial team using React, Redux, and GraphQL.
highlights: Executed A/B tests, including a mobile carousel enhancement projecting $150M in annual incremental revenue.
Built an internal Chrome extension to automate auth syncing, improving developer workflow times by 90%.

work.name: Heat.wav
work.summary: Led technical development of a location-based music & artist discovery platform that placed in the quarterfinals at NYU InnoVention, and semifinals at RU Innovators.
highlights: Built and deployed a location-based mobile app from scratch, managing the full lifecycle from Figma prototyping to Heroku/Testflight deployment.
